notes.title: Hierolgyph: Prologue is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35691628/5cfcd81173592fba82986e8655caac7acd78958b.png[/img]

[h1]About[/h1]
The game is called "Hieroglyph". In this action platformer you will perform as Fenice, a person who got inside of his own consciousness. He must find the way out and lock his own demons in the deeps of heart, or "destroy" them.

[previewyoutube=IGEyzFj-PME;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
Using gamepad is highly recommended, however, you can always edit your preferences in the main menu options, here is the defaults.
[list]
[*] Space - Jump
[*] Key up/ down/ left/ right
[*] E - Attack/ Use
[*] Q - Change weapon mode
[*] W - Charge the superior mode (maybe you'll need something to use it)

[*] f4 - Fullsceen
[*] Backspace - hold in controls options to return to defaults
[*] Esc - pause
[/list]

[h3]P.S.[/h3]
There may be some bugs and problems in this game, if you find any - make a discussion or knock-knock here:
https://twitter.com/Manti_core_dev
